name: Automo
description:
Automo is one workspace for making things and running the business around them: designs, documents, spreadsheets and video projects on one side; files, brand assets, knowledge base, mail, calendar, tasks, customers, support and campaigns on the other.

Connect it and you can work with all of it from a conversation. Ask what you have on a launch and get one answer across files, brand assets, knowledge base, chats, projects and contacts. Ask what was agreed on a call and get the transcript, then have the follow-up drafted and read back to you before anything sends.

Everything it makes is a real Automo project. Open it in the editor, hand it to a colleague, keep going.

Your workspace admin decides what it can reach. Permissions are set per workspace and apply to everyone already connected, so a permission can be withdrawn without anyone reconnecting. Anything that touches personal mail, customer records or confidential folders starts switched off. Every tool call is logged, and any person's access can be revoked on its own.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Automo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Automo to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mo.automo.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Automo MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Automo lists 113 MCP tools, including add_brand_asset, add_design_page, add_design_to_screen, add_element, add_elements, add_project_comment, add_ticket_note, create_automation, create_blank_project, create_brand_kit, create_calendar_event, and create_campaign.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Automo?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Automo in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Automo requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Automo is developed by Automo. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
